rows.grounds: noun antardhāna in accusative singular neuter; object or destination of yayau
verb yā, third singular active aorist
compound brahma-ādi in genitive plural masculine; genitive absolute with prapaśyatām
participle pra-paś in genitive plural masculine; genitive absolute with brahmādīnāṃ

items.question: How does the goddess vanish from Indra's sight while Brahmā and others still see her?
premises: The goddess announces she will reveal her form to Indra.
She then disappears in the sight of Brahmā and others.
The disappearance occurs at that place.
items.inference: The verse records a sudden concealment witnessed by Brahmā and others.
uncertainties: The subject of yayau is not explicit in this verse.
Whether antardhānaṃ is destination or result is ambiguous.
items.plain_english: She vanished there, while Brahmā and the others looked on.
